name: render_a2ui
description: Show a reply laid out as one small screen in the chat app (A2UI 1.0), for when the person compares or acts on several things at once: places with the next step, a day with a clash to settle, a chart with a table. Send one message: {"version": "1.0", "createSurface": {"surfaceId": "dinner-tonight", "catalogId": "github.com/fifteen02/traceflow:chat/v1", "components": [...]}}. Components are a flat list: each has an id and a component (Text, Row, Column, Card, Divider, Button, VegaChart, Places, Schedule, Table, Sources), names its children by id, and one has the id root. Values are literal; when many items share a shape, put them in createSurface.dataModel and write the shape once: children {"path": "/items", "componentId": "item"}, values {"@path": "name"} (relative inside it), amounts and dates {"@call": "formatCurrency", "args": {...}}. A Button's action.event.userMessage is sent as the person's next message when they press it. Say the point in words first; load the a2ui skill for each piece's fields, the layouts and examples. A surface that breaks a rule is refused with one line per problem: fix them and call again. Only shows it; there is no reply.

messages.description: One message: createSurface with its surfaceId, catalogId and components
